# Fluri Themes

An independent collection of interactive website effects founded by František Gejdoš.

- Founder biography: https://fluri.xyz/founder/ — František Gejdoš (Frantisek Gejdos), founder of Fluri Themes and creator of Winter, Spider, Grinch, Black Cat and Ghost.
- Brand: https://fluri.xyz/
- Winter: https://winter.fluri.xyz/ — interactive snowfall, DOM-aware snow accumulation and optional Christmas effects. npm: @fluritheme/fluri and @fluritheme/fluri-react.
- Spider: https://spider.fluri.xyz/ — an animated jumping spider that physically weaves persistent silk and explores the page. npm: @fluritheme/spider.
- Source: https://github.com/fluritheme
- Privacy: https://fluri.xyz/privacy/

The runtime libraries do not report visitors or installations. Each product's documentation and playground live on its own subdomain. Website traffic is combined in one private dashboard at https://fluri.xyz/dashboard/; former subdomain dashboards redirect there. Former snow-product paths at fluri.xyz redirect to Winter; legacy APIs remain compatible.

- Grinch: https://grinch.fluri.xyz/ — a holiday character with animated gift heists, hiding and kindness mode. npm: @fluritheme/grinch. Source: https://github.com/fluritheme/grinch.

## Licensing

Current commercial releases require a EUR 19 one-time Lifetime License for production use, including unlimited personal and client websites and all current and future themes. Private non-production evaluation and public official demos are available before purchase. No runtime activation or telemetry. Canonical terms: https://fluri.xyz/license/. Winter and Spider releases through 0.2.1, and Grinch through 0.1.1, remain MIT. Licensing does not retroactively change those releases.

## Black Cat

https://cat.fluri.xyz/ — A DOM-aware black cat that walks on page elements, stalks the pointer, plays with yarn, hides and sleeps. Commercial from 0.1.0; included in the Fluri lifetime licence. npm: @fluritheme/black-cat.

## Ghost

https://ghost.fluri.xyz/ — A shy website ghost with fluid floating, real hiding places, peeking and illustrated disguises. Commercial from 0.1.0, included in the Fluri lifetime licence. npm: @fluritheme/ghost.

## Rainy Window

https://rain.fluri.xyz/ — Transparent glass droplets, coalescence, runoff trails and pointer wiping. Created by František Gejdoš, founder of Fluri Themes. Commercial from 0.1.0; included in the EUR 19 lifetime licence. npm: @fluritheme/rainy-window.

## Tiny Builders

https://builders.fluri.xyz/ — A coordinated crew that builds four different project types on real page surfaces. Work orders, supplies, trucks, scaffolds, cranes, coffee, repairs and demolition. Created by František Gejdoš. Commercial from 0.1.0; included in the EUR 19 lifetime licence. npm: @fluritheme/tiny-builders.
